title: The Alibi of the Fens
author: Jude Villalobos
blurb: Vesper Delacroix, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
